content: <thought>We have identified the three logical disconnections: (1) amide bond cleavage to give an aromatic carboxylic acid and an aniline, (2) Doebner modification disconnection of the α,β‑unsaturated acid into the corresponding aryl aldehyde and malonic acid, and (3) sulfonamide formation disconnection into a primary aryl amine and an aryl sulfonyl chloride. The appropriate retrosynthetic templates can be retrieved from the catalog using these functional‑group criteria. Once the template IDs are known, we can construct the required JSON route with three reaction nodes, each listing the precursor SMILES.
